title: Verify incident entries against primary sources
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. docs/research/incidents.md lists 26 incidents; only 3 are 'Verified (primary)'. The rest rely on press coverage of official findings.
objective: Upgrade as many entries as possible to 'Verified (primary)' by locating the regulator or official reports (state agencies, Japan MLIT, Sweden SHK, UK HSE, Technical Safety BC, court records), and list the public-records requests needed for the rest.
acceptanceCriteria: Each upgraded entry links the primary document
No entry is upgraded without a primary source; facts that conflict with the primary source are corrected and the correction noted
A table of outstanding public-records/FOIA requests (agency, what to request, how)
Victims are not named; tally section updated
